topics.title: C Program Structure, Compilation & Primitive Types
topics.objective: Understand gcc compilation pipeline, main entry point, and primitive scalar data types.
topics.exercise: Write a CLI program to compute Fahrenheit to Celsius conversion with formatted output.

topics.title: Conditionals, Loops & Branching
topics.objective: Master deterministic iteration and Boolean branching logic without off-by-one errors.
topics.example: for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (i % 2 == 0) continue; }
topics.exercise: Implement prime number factorization using nested loops and break/continue statements.

topics.title: Pointers, Memory Addresses & Dereferencing
topics.objective: Comprehend pointer arithmetic, stack addresses, pass-by-reference semantics, and NULL safety.
topics.exercise: Implement a safe in-place string reversal function using pointer traversal.

topics.title: Dynamic Memory Allocation (malloc, free, realloc)
topics.objective: Manage heap memory life cycles, prevent memory leaks, and guard against dangling pointers.
topics.example: int *arr = malloc(n * sizeof(int)); if (!arr) return -1; free(arr);
topics.exercise: Construct a dynamically resizing integer vector with push and pop operations.

topics.title: Structs, Typedefs & Linked Data Structures
topics.objective: Encapsulate compound data using structures and build pointer-linked nodes.
topics.example: typedef struct Node { int val; struct Node *next; } Node;
topics.exercise: Implement a singly linked list with insertion, deletion, and memory deallocation.
